node.label: polycystic lipomembranous osteodysplasia with sclerosing leukoencephaly
node.definition: A rare inherited leukodystrophy characterized by progressive presenile dementia associated with recurrent bone fractures due to polycystic osseous lesions of the lower and upper extremities.
synonyms: polycystic lipomembranous osteodysplasia with sclerosing leukoencephalopathy
